Title: Work and Live in Austria

Please check the requirements for working and living in Austria.
Create a process that assists you for a combination of the steps.

Include:
* Organizing accomodation and bank account (negotiation)
* Visa (every x amount of months) - Rot-Weiss-Rot Card

Requirements
General principles and requirements for the issue of Visas:
* visa application form
* a travel document valid ...
* passport photo ...
* presentation of fully comprehensive travel health insurance ...
* proof of sufficient means of subsistence ...
* other evidence requested ... (hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket, proof of gainful employment etc.) ... may vary depending on location
* absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country)

Depending on circumstances, additional documents may be requested.
Please contact representation in advance for more information.

Generally speaking, all visa types are issued by representation offices (→ BMEIA) abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension of the visa is permitted, by the state police headquarters.

Schengen visas must be issued by representation office of country in which main travel destination located.
If applicant intends equal time in several countries (touring), competent office is that of country whose territory main travel destination located, on basis of length and purpose.
If not possible to determine main travel destination, member country of first entry responsible.

Territorial competence for applications for category A and C visas falls to representation office in consular district where legal place of residence of applicant located.
A representation office may claim exceptional competence for applications from third-country nationals legally residing but not registered in their district if applicant can provide justification why submitted to that consulate.

Type D visas, however, must be applied for at competent Austrian representation.
Provisions Section 8 FPG apply.
In accordance with these, territorial competence for carrying out official actions in relation to visas determined on basis of foreign national's place of residence (centre of interest, verifiable by registration forms, residence permit, visa).

List of representation offices (addresses, telephone, opening hours, special requirements) on website BMEIA.
